detailed_description:
The target video has a cinematic, photorealistic live-action quality with rich surface detail, layered natural lighting, and no on-screen text, subtitles, BGM, or music.
[Shot 1] The video begins exactly from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> sits in the white bathtub, a white towel wrapped around its head, amber eyes looking toward the camera, pink cheeks flushed, a rounded belly above the water. Its right hand rests on the tub edge with fingers curled around it, while its left hand is submerged. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 1> blinks both eyes quickly once, Its right fingers grip the bathtub edge, and its upper body leans slightly forward.


overall_soundscape:
The soundscape contains only diegetic bathroom ambience: gentle water lapping against the tub, small ripple sounds from finger pokes and hand slaps, faint wet fur and towel rustling, soft hand contact against the bathtub edge and belly. There are no subtitles, no BGM, and no music.
